summary: 本 backlog package 固化流程优化线的优先级、边界和下一阶段入口，确保 WORKFLOW-001 只用于 agile-improvement 流程自身优化，不直接承担真实项目交付。
decisions: 流程优化使用 agile-improvement 线，真实项目验证另开 project-delivery case。
当前阶段先把流程契约、签核链、rollback 和 live/runtime 对齐做稳。
下一阶段 sprint-planning 必须把 backlog 变成带负责人、先后顺序和验证节点的任务计划。

inScope: signoff and release issuance on agile stages
handoff contract to a future project-delivery case
outOfScope: building the model API relay platform in this case
running real Discovery/Intelligence/PRD inside this workflow case
formal host switch or TriMC production hosting

prioritizedBacklog.title: 固化 agile stage 合同与签核链
doneWhen: backlog 到 validation-handoff 的阶段输出合同固定
owner -> CEO -> CEOChiefOfStaff 签核顺序可在 live case 上稳定运行

prioritizedBacklog.title: 保持流程优化线与项目交付线边界清晰
doneWhen: WORKFLOW case 不再承担真实项目 Discovery/Intelligence/PRD
后续 project-delivery 开案入口口径明确

prioritizedBacklog.title: 生成 sprint-planning 计划包
doneWhen: 给出 sprint goal、任务拆分、顺序和验证节点
明确下一阶段需要的产品与技术支持

prioritizedBacklog.title: 补齐训练与操作说明
doneWhen: 训练与操作文档使用新的 process-improvement vs project-delivery 分流口径
live support-root 与 source 资产口径一致

entryCriteriaForNextStage: sprint-planning package can translate backlog into executable tasks
risks: Scope may drift back into pseudo-delivery if the split is not enforced.
Live support-root and source runtime may diverge without explicit verification at each stage.
Weak sprint-planning output would make later release issuance low-confidence.
